docRequirement: typescript.md:1157 lists `SDKInformationalMessage` as a member of the `SDKMessage` union, and :1394-1408 defines it as `{ type: "system"; subtype: "informational"; content: string; level: "info" | "notice" | "suggestion" | "warning"; tool_use_id?: string; prevent_continuation?: boolean; ... }` with the binding sentence: "Generic text banner emitted by the loop. Carries non-error status lines, hook feedback such as a `UserPromptSubmit` hook's block reason, and command output. Render `content` as plaintext at the given `level`." A host consuming the SDK stream must render `content` at `level`, not drop it.
current: The Claude backend never handles the subtype. `adaptSystem` (packages/shared/src/agent/backend/claude/event-adapter.ts:622-656) is an if/else chain over `init`, `compact_boundary`, `status`+`compacting` and `task_notification` with NO trailing else, so an `informational` message falls out having pushed nothing. `case 'system'` in `adapt` (same file, :224-226) is the only route for system messages, and the generic debug line at :196-201 logs `message.type` only — 'SDK message: system' — never the subtype, `content`, `level`, `tool_use_id` or `prevent_continuation`. `grep -an "'system'|subtype" packages/shared/src/agent/claude-agent.ts` returns 0 hits, so there is no second consumer. NUL-safe `grep -ran` for the subtype strings over packages+apps (*.ts/*.tsx) gives 0 code hits for `informational` (the 11 hits are unrelated prose about connector rows) and 0 repo-wide for `local_command_output`; both types are declared by the installed SDK at node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.d.ts:3556-3576 and :3586-3593 (0.3.183). Reachability of the hook-feedback case: claude-agent.ts:1288 takes `this.automationSystem?.buildSdkHooks?.()` and :1602 merges it into the SDK `hooks` option, so under Claude the automation runs inside the SDK, not host-side; hooks-automation.ts:1621-1656 builds a callback for every configured event including `UserPromptSubmit`, and `automationResultToSdkHookResult` (:1673-1683) maps a block to `{ continue: false, decision: 'block', reason }`. claude-agent.ts has 0 hits for `UserPromptSubmit`/`emitAutomationEvent`, so ClaudeAgent has no host-side prompt gate and no second channel for the reason; `SessionManager.reportHookErrors` (packages/server-core/src/sessions/SessionManager.ts:5421-5450) is wired only into the `executeAgentEvent` arm of `trackAgentAutomationSystem` (:5384-5391), not the `buildSdkHooks` arm (:5392-5405), and covers non-blocking hook failures rather than decisions. The three sibling backends do surface it: packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:6430, packages/shared/src/agent/codex-agent.ts:462-467, packages/shared/src/agent/nestor-cloud-agent.ts:275-278. Everything downstream of the adapter already exists: the client DTO `packages/shared/src/protocol/dto.ts:372` declares `{ type: 'info'; ...; level?: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success' }`, the renderer's `InfoEvent` (apps/electron/src/renderer/event-processor/types.ts:230-238) carries `level`, handlers/session.ts:296 copies it to `Message.infoLevel`, and ChatDisplay.tsx:3061-3067 renders icon+colour per level; SessionManager already emits levelled info events at :6604 and :15556. The only holes on that path are the internal union `packages/core/src/types/message.ts:968` — `| { type: 'info'; message: string }`, no `level` — and `case 'info'` in SessionManager (:18018-18065), whose `sendEvent` at :18059-18065 sends `message`, `statusType` and `timestamp` but no `level`.
divergence: The `informational` subtype is unhandled outright — not mis-keyed and not narrowed. `adaptSystem` has no branch for it and no trailing else, so `content`, `level`, `tool_use_id` and `prevent_continuation` are discarded leaving only a 'SDK message: system' debug line that names the type and nothing else. Because the wire event and the renderer already carry a level, the delta is one missing adapter branch plus one missing optional `level` field on the internal `AgentEvent` `info` variant and its forwarding in SessionManager. One value-level trap: the doc's four levels (`info` | `notice` | `suggestion` | `warning`) are NOT our four (`info` | `warning` | `error` | `success`), so the branch owes an explicit mapping — the vocabularies differ, not just the key name. The `local_command_output` half of the filed row is excluded as unreachable: this fork resolves slash commands first-party and hands the SDK only `SDK_SLASH_COMMANDS = ['compact']` (claude-agent.ts:1665), whose output arrives as `compact_boundary`, already handled.

change.what: Add an `else if (msg.subtype === 'informational')` branch before the chain closes at :655. Narrow off the SDK's exported `SDKInformationalMessage` rather than the file's `as any`. When `content` is a non-empty string, push `{ type: 'info', message: content, level: mapped }`; skip an empty `content`. Map the doc's level vocabulary onto ours: 'info'->'info', 'notice'->'info', 'suggestion'->'info', 'warning'->'warning' ('error'/'success' are unreachable from this subtype). Do NOT synthesize `type: 'error'` — the page calls this a non-error banner, and the three sibling backends only use `error` because they have no other channel at the block site. Also add a trailing `else { this.callbacks.onDebug?.(`Unhandled system subtype: ${msg.subtype}`); }` so the next unhandled system subtype leaves a trace instead of vanishing (the SDK declares several more: worker_shutting_down, commands_changed, hook_started, ...). `prevent_continuation` needs no terminal handling — the SDK still emits a `result` — but log it rather than drop it silently.

One line: `| { type: 'info'; message: string; level?: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success' }`. Reuse verbatim the vocabulary already on `Message.infoLevel` (:307, :401) and on the wire DTO (packages/shared/src/protocol/dto.ts:372); do not invent a fifth value.

Add `...(event.level ? { level: event.level } : {})` to the `sendEvent` at :18059-18065 so the level reaches the DTO field that already exists. Then decide persistence: today only `isCompactionComplete` pushes a `Message`, so a warning-level banner is transient and gone on reload, while `reportHookErrors` (:5421-5450) persists its equivalents as `role: 'info', infoLevel: 'warning'`. Recommend persisting when `level === 'warning'` for parity with that path — a block reason that disappears on reload is the same silence in slow motion. This sub-item, and only this one, touches session persistence.

`info: { required: ['message'], optional: ['level'] }`. The test pins the union three ways — this constant, the JSON fixture, and a regex scrape of message.ts source (agentEventFields, :176-185; assertions :405-433) — so all three must move in the same commit or it fails.
`"optionalFields": ["level"]`. No `variantIsolation` change is needed: only `complete` and `permission_request_cancelled` have isolation lists and `level` appears in no other AgentEvent variant.

Add cases beside the existing compact_boundary/status ones: (1) positive — a `warning`-level informational carrying a `UserPromptSubmit` block reason yields exactly `{ type: 'info', message: <content>, level: 'warning' }`; (2) boundary — `notice` and `suggestion` collapse to `level: 'info'`, and an empty `content` yields no event; (3) negative — an unrecognised system subtype still yields no events. `adaptSystem` currently has no covering test of its own, so these are the first.

blastRadius: `adaptSystem` has exactly one caller (`adapt`, event-adapter.ts:225) and no covering test today; `ClaudeEventAdapter` has 6 callers across packages/shared/src/agent/backend/claude/index.ts, backend/index.ts and claude-agent.ts. The `AgentEvent` `info` variant is a cross-backend contract — emitted by pi-agent.ts, codex-agent.ts, nestor-cloud-agent.ts and this adapter, consumed by SessionManager `case 'info'` (:18018) and matched on literal text by claude-agent.ts:1822 (`event.message === 'Compacted Conversation'`) and pi-agent.ts:2724 (`startsWith('Compacted')`); adding an optional field leaves those untouched, but the `message` string must not change. It is pinned by adjacent-backend-frozen-contract.test.ts in three places (EVENT_FIELDS, the JSON fixture, a source-text scrape) — a partial edit fails the suite. WIRE: no new wire field — packages/shared/src/protocol/dto.ts:372 already declares `level?` on the `info` event, and the renderer already reads it (event-processor/types.ts:230-238, handlers/session.ts:274/296, ChatDisplay.tsx:3061-3067), so the adapter change alone is wire-neutral. PERSISTENCE: only the optional step-3 persistence sub-item crosses the session-persistence boundary — it writes `Message.infoLevel` (message.ts:307/401), which apps/electron/src/main/__tests__/session-message-parity.test.ts:221-227 already asserts is persisted and restored; take that sub-item and that parity test joins the gate. Backend scope is Claude-only: NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE is off by default at build time, so default builds are unaffected.
userImpact: In a Claude-backend session, an automation that blocks a prompt on `UserPromptSubmit` refuses the prompt and tells the user nothing about why. The hook's reason string reaches the SDK (hooks-automation.ts:1673-1683), comes back only on the `informational` banner, and the adapter discards it. What the user sees is the turn ending with no explanation — not literal silence, because the SDK still emits a `result` and adaptResult (:581-601) turns that into a bare completion or a generic 'Query failed'. The identical automation under Pi, Codex or Nestor Cloud prints the reason as an error message, so this is a visible per-backend inconsistency for anyone with prompt-gating automations. The same missing branch also swallows every other loop banner Claude sends — non-error status lines and `warning`/`suggestion`-level notices — so an enabled-Claude user is quietly missing a whole display channel the other three backends have. Latent in the shipped default build (NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE off); it surfaces the moment a Claude-enabled build meets any configured UserPromptSubmit automation.

Two things I did NOT verify by running the product, hence stated as inference rather than measurement: (a) that the Claude CLI actually emits `informational` on a UserPromptSubmit block — that rests on the doc sentence and the SDK's own JSDoc at sdk.d.ts:3555 ('hook feedback (e.g. a UserPromptSubmit hook's block reason)'), not on a live capture; (b) the precise visible outcome of a blocked prompt today — the filed row called it a 'silent turn', but from adaptResult it is a completion, possibly with a generic error, so 'no reason given' is certain while 'nothing at all' is not. The level mapping ('notice'/'suggestion' -> 'info') is my proposal, not a doc requirement: the SDK's render hints (sdk.d.ts:3564-3566 — 'notice' renders in inactive gray, 'suggestion' and 'warning' are more prominent) would justify extending `Message.infoLevel` with the two missing values instead, at the cost of touching the renderer's level config map at ChatDisplay.tsx:3062-3067 and the persistence parity test.
